item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.30), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)] Harvard's $2.2B SpaceX Stake Tops Amazon, Nvidia Bets - SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX)
item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] Nuclear Power Renaissance Drives Long-Term Growth
item.description:

Companies like Constellation Energy (CEG) and Cameco (CCJ) are well-positioned to benefit from this trend, showing strong revenue growth and significant uranium reserves, respectively. item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] RKLB Stock Rises Overnight: Rocket Lab’s First 8 Satellites From $143M Globalstar Deal Reach Orbit
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)

These satellites, part of a 17-platform deal, will support Globalstar’s direct-to-device communications and IoT services. The successful deployment highlights Rocket Lab's expanded capabilities beyond just launch services, including spacecraft platform design, build, testing, and on-orbit operations, further strengthening its position in the defense sector with significant contracts from the U.S. Space Force and Space Development Agency.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.38)] Michigan lawsuit alleges Apple has failed to "adequately protect" people from being stalked with AirTags
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.38)
A lawsuit filed in Michigan alleges that Apple has not adequately protected individuals from being stalked using AirTags. The suit, brought by two Southeast Michigan residents, claims Apple was aware of the potential for misuse when the product launched in 2021 and that it has since received over 40,000 stalking reports. The plaintiffs are seeking to prevent Apple from continuing what they call "unlawful or unfair practices" related to the design and sale of AirTags.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.48)] Nvidia’s neocloud funding could drive significant revenue stream - Morgan Stanley
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.48)
Morgan Stanley analysts are optimistic about Nvidia's recent announcement of securing $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure, viewing it as a potential significant annuity revenue stream. They believe this initiative, which involves partnerships with major financial players like Apollo and BlackRock, will address unmet compute demand and add predictability to Nvidia's long-term earnings, especially with the upcoming Vera Rubin product cycle. The analysts estimate that if Nvidia captures even a quarter of the potential $500 billion annual revenue from a neocloud ecosystem, it could significantly boost its EBIT and EPS.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.12)] Safeway closes more stores as Albertsons restructures after failed Kroger deal
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (-0.12)
Safeway is closing more stores as its parent company Albertsons restructures following the failed $24.6 billion merger with Kroger. The closures, which include at least three locations in 2026, are part of Albertsons' efforts to optimize its store network after the merger was blocked on antitrust grounds. The company is also undergoing a broader restructuring initiative, ACI Edge, and has cut its full-year earnings guidance due to declining identical grocery sales and a cautious consumer environment.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.13)] Residents of Kherson are suing Ubiquiti over drone attacks
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.13)

item.description:
